relationship_to_prior_versions.changed_component: CLUTRR surface construction and source-group-aware allocation only

immutable_candidate_scope.semantic_identity: Ordered JSON array [target_relation, relation_1, relation_2, relation_3], SHA-256 hashed.
immutable_candidate_scope.entity_normalization: entity_0, entity_1, ... by first appearance in the stored clean graph

sentence_parser.precondition: Every normalized_story contains exactly three nonempty sentences, ends in a period, and each source relation template contains no internal period.
sentence_parser.algorithm: Remove the final period, split on the literal delimiter '. ', and append one period to each of the three resulting strings.

sentence_permutation_expansion.permuted_story: Join the three indexed normalized sentences with one ASCII space.
sentence_permutation_expansion.duplicate_rule: Deduplicate identical (normalized_input, target_relation); conflicting semantic IDs are fatal.
sentence_permutation_expansion.row_order: Ascending SHA-256(normalized_input + semantic_serialization + target_relation), then source_group_id, then permutation index.
sentence_permutation_expansion.source_group_invariance: All six permutations derived from one V1 source surface share one source_group_id.

pairing_rule: Group eligible semantic patterns by target relation.
Within each target group sort semantic IDs by SHA-256.
Sort all candidate pairs by SHA-256 of the concatenated ordered semantic IDs.

evaluation_allocation.rule: Sort complete source groups by source_group_id. Take all six permutations from groups 0 through 32 and the first two registered permutations from group 33.
evaluation_allocation.unused_rows: The remaining four permutations of evaluation group 33 are excluded from all manifests.

exposure_allocation.rule: After the 34 evaluation groups, take all six permutations from groups 34 through 43 and the first four registered permutations from group 44.
exposure_allocation.unused_rows: The remaining two permutations of exposure group 44 are excluded from all manifests.

training_arms.common_base_rule: Use only non-target semantic IDs. Allocate expanded rows round-robin over target relation, semantic ID, source_group_id, then registered permutation order; take the first 22,720.
training_arms.assignment: Bit 0 exposes pair member 0 in A and member 1 in B; bit 1 reverses this. Pair members share the same target relation.
training_arms.paired_slots: Common-base row IDs are byte-identical across arms. Exposure permutation index slots align within each pair.
training_arms.strictness: Every target semantic ID has exactly 64 rows in one arm and zero in the complementary arm for each seed.
training_arms.label_balance: A/B label counts must be identical for every seed.

model_and_optimization.architecture: Frozen external-behavior-v1 four-layer byte Transformer: d_model 128, four heads, FFN 512, learned positions, CLS pooling, dropout 0.1, maximum length 512.

behavioral_analysis.primary_estimand: 100/(8*40) times the sum over model seeds and target patterns of exposed minus unexposed row-weighted target-pattern accuracy.
behavioral_analysis.positive_behavioral_go: tau >= +1.0 pp and the 95% interval lower endpoint is > 0.
behavioral_analysis.negative_behavioral_go: tau <= -1.0 pp and the 95% interval upper endpoint is < 0.
behavioral_analysis.null_equivalence_go: the complete 95% interval is contained in [-0.5,+0.5] pp.

required: frozen source input hash and row count match
every source row has exactly three parseable sentences
all six registered permutations preserve the source semantic ID
expanded rows have no conflicting surface semantics
at least 20 same-label eligible pattern pairs exist
exactly 40 target patterns and 20 pairs are selected
every target has 34 evaluation and 11 exposure source groups
evaluation and exposure source groups are disjoint
exactly 8000 evaluation and 2560 exposure rows are frozen
common base has 22720 rows and zero target semantic IDs
all 16 arm manifests have 24000 rows and paired label counts
all allocated inputs fit 512 bytes without truncation
frozen model implementation matches the registered architecture
